# P2a UX source review

Verdict: **PASS for source-only UX scope** at `e0cfad266fce1a29e065ef016815f695ced9810b`. No runtime, native UI, performance, task-completion or original-test parity credit.

No blocking findings in the raw identity transport scope.

- **Existing sync and selection workflows — PASS_STATIC**: Diff from task base touches no android_ui, project, project_model.rs, generated_artifacts.rs or gradle_import.rs consumers. Basic and V2 emission expressions are retained; importFacts is additive. No production Rust caller publishes imported names, facets or tree state.

- **No guessed identity — PASS_STATIC**: Bridge invokes named Gradle getters, observes IdeaPlugin via findPlugin without applying it, and serializes nullable Idea names. Decoder retains absent Option, explicit available(null), available(empty) and unavailable(capability/detail) as distinct values; public and reference identity paths remain separate.

- **Root, folder, nested and collision identity — PASS_STATIC**: Raw ordered allprojects catalogue retains root/noncompiled holders. Name and directory fields are independent. Index is keyed by Gradle path; duplicate paths reject while colliding names remain raw. Successful parent observations must match the local path and name an observed parent holder. Authored fixture and tests cover configured root name different from folder, relocated nested directory, collisions and missing holders.

- **Model and selection freshness — PASS_STATIC**: Snapshot binds exact root plus ordered module/path/directory/kind/variant identity and caller model_revision/selection_revision/selected_variants. Invalid selected module or variant and duplicates return typed errors. ensure_current rejects changed binding or Basic identity.

- **Partial getter errors — PASS_STATIC**: Optional unavailable observations preserve other fields. Missing/failed required observations return MissingMetadata or Capability; malformed observations and contradictory available identities reject separately. parse_import_facts borrows Basic model and cannot erase it; Basic parsing is unchanged.

- **Late configuration — PASS_STATIC_WITH_RUNTIME_PENDING**: Capture now runs in taskGraph.whenReady after project-evaluation callbacks. Authored late_configuration.gradle changes Idea module name in projectsEvaluated and prints an independent final getter oracle during a task. Actual Gradle capture/oracle comparison is pending; no executed timing credit.

- **Existing restrictions and completion claims — PASS_STATIC**: Included-build and standalone com.android.test guards retained. Report tracks Java-only Basic import, TAPI names, Kotlin/facet policy, logical tree publication and shipping physical tree limitations. Scope does not claim full Android Studio workflows or original test parity.

The reviewed semantic source was `5147e2b577a78d7259c64fb0b3079f2a229aef18`. The owner subsequently applied authorized direct rustfmt to only the new Rust source and tests. I independently verified before/after hashes, unchanged function names, unchanged string literals in order, and 28 unchanged test attributes. This review binds to the resulting commit `e0cfad266fce1a29e065ef016815f695ced9810b`. I executed no formatter or runtime tooling.

All 28 supplemental tests were read but not executed. All six retained helper/API reference files match their manifest sizes and SHA-256 values. Source hashes, unchanged-consumer diff checks and explicit pending gates are recorded in `ux-static.json`.

Actual Gradle verification must compare the late configuration getter oracle with the captured sidecar; source inspection alone does not establish JVM callback timing. Full-app/native and CI gates remain required by `.rules` before scoped completion.

The physical project tree and Sync console model JSON limitation remain tracked. Imported names, facets, tree publication and Kotlin/Java/XML LSP workflows remain outside this transport review.
